themes.label: CHINA PLATFORMS
themes.note: Hong Kong is where the mainland's internet platforms list. These are the consumer-facing names whose revenue is advertising, commissions, gaming and cloud — the group most sensitive to Chinese consumption and to regulation.

themes.label: SEMICONDUCTORS & HARDWARE
themes.note: The hardware chain: foundry, components, optics and devices. It is the Hong Kong leg of the same supply chain the Taiwan market covers, and the part of it that sits under export controls.

themes.label: EV & AUTO
themes.note: Chinese carmakers and their suppliers, priced in Hong Kong. Volume growth, price wars and export tariffs all land in these lines — the demand side of the copper and aluminium in the COMMODITIES tab.

themes.label: BANKS & INSURERS
themes.note: The financial plumbing: the HKMA-regulated banks, the mainland's big-four lenders listed here, and the insurers. Dividends and property exposure are the two things that move them.

themes.label: ENERGY & UTILITIES
themes.note: Oil and gas producers, coal, and the power utilities. The upstream names track Brent and Henry Hub; the utilities track the fuel they burn and the tariff they are allowed to charge.

themes.label: PROPERTY
themes.note: Hong Kong landlords and the mainland developers listed beside them. Two very different businesses: the first collects rent in HKD, the second is still working through a credit cycle.

themes.label: CONSUMER
themes.note: Food, drink, sportswear and retail. The read is the same as the mainland's macro data, but company by company — and several of these names are the ones foreign investors can actually buy.

themes.label: HEALTHCARE
themes.note: Generic drugmakers, distributors, biotech and the contract research organisations. Policy pricing on the mainland is the swing factor, and the CXO names carry global pharma demand as well.

themes.label: METALS & MATERIALS
themes.note: Gold miners, copper, aluminium, steel and cement. This is the Hong Kong market's direct link to the industrial-metals and precious-metals segments — the same story priced in HKD.

themes.label: HONG KONG LOCAL
themes.note: The locally listed conglomerates, utilities and landlords whose earnings are Hong Kong itself: rents, electricity, gas, tolls and the port. The HKMA's rate and the property cycle are the drivers.
